# Offline content libraries

These browser files are bundled locally with Quiznet. There are no runtime CDN requests.

- `highlight.min.js`: highlight.js 11.12.0 from the exact `@highlightjs/cdn-assets` npm package, plus the language files selected by `code-policy.js`. BSD-3-Clause; see `highlight.LICENSE`.
- `markdown-it.min.js`: markdown-it 15.0.3's browser UMD build from its exact npm package. MIT; see `markdown-it.LICENSE`.

Regenerate with `npm run assets:content`. `npm run check` verifies these assets and licenses against the locked packages, allowing Windows line endings. Change the shared language catalog and regenerate to add a language supplied by highlight.js. Review and audit package updates before copying them.

Quiznet disables raw HTML in Markdown and passes the result through its HTML allowlist. Syntax highlighting operates only on code text and never executes it. Imported class names and attributes are discarded; code language hints are validated and highlighting classes are generated by the bundled highlighter. Unknown languages and long snippets remain readable as escaped text.
